Contract: OCI image contract: HomeHub supplies the JSON config plus read-only source/config and writable source-state/backup/change/log bind mounts; SourceStatePath stores the source hash-cache MANIFEST.csv outside the read-only source. The one-shot container returns 0 only for a complete run and deposits Windows/POSIX recovery entry points. One BackupSet per container invocation — HomeHub runs one service/invocation per directory (ruled 2026-08-21); multi-set configs are a native-Windows convenience. HomeHub owns mount-identity preflight, scheduling, retention POLICY, and NagLight translation around that exit status; HomeHub must never delete Snapshot_* folders directly — snapshot pruning is FileBackup's mechanism (planned Prune-Snapshot verb; dedup means one snapshot's bytes may be the only physical copy other snapshots recover by hash). See README 'Run as a Linux container'. Restore outcome is reported through the exit-code table documented in README 'Restore exit codes' (0 complete; 1 content unrecoverable; 2 usage/precondition; 3 manifest-witness verification failure; 4 host/dependency failure — retriable), identical for RECONSTRUCT.bat and reconstruct.sh; a restore origin's MANIFEST.csv is witnessed by MANIFEST.csv.meta which both restorers verify before writing anything (SR-038/SR-039/SR-040).
